title: When was the oldest mythic card released and what are its legal play format
question:
When was the oldest mythic card released and what are its legal play formats?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: the oldest card refers to MIN(originalReleaseDate); mythic card refers to rarity = 'mythic'; legal play refers to status = 'legal'; play format refers to format

prediction.sql: SELECT c.XCL_051 AS originalReleaseDate, l.XCL_084 AS format FROM cards AS "c" JOIN legalities AS "l" ON "l".XCL_086 = "c".XCL_072 WHERE c.XCL_059 = 'mythic' AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal' AND c.XCL_051 = (SELECT MIN(c2.XCL_051) FROM cards AS c2 WHERE c2.XCL_059 = 'mythic' AND NOT c2.XCL_051 IS NULL)

arguments.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_051 AS originalReleaseDate, l.XCL_084 AS format
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
WHERE c.XCL_059 = 'mythic'
  AND l.XCL_085 = 'legal'
  AND c.XCL_051 = (
    SELECT MIN(c2.XCL_051)
    FROM cards c2
    WHERE c2.XCL_059 = 'mythic'
      AND c2.XCL_051 IS NOT NULL
  );
